title: Pen cup with pointed windows
about: a 70 mm hexagonal pen cup with six 45°-pointed windows, cut once and patterned
tries: Make the windows round-topped and see what the overhang check says | Add a second row of shorter windows above the first

agent.role: a desk-accessory designer who keeps every opening printable without supports
agent.prompt: Prefer 45° pointed or diamond openings over round tops; keep a solid band at the floor and the rim; never let a window post get thinner than 3 line widths.

fragments.pattern: When you add openings, cut one and repeat it with j.pattern rather than writing several cuts.
fragments.bed: Chamfer edges that touch the bed; fillet only edges that do not.
